description: A ground-level photograph depicts an agro-forestry landscape featuring numerous trees with light-coloured, relatively slender trunks and dense green canopies. The ground beneath the trees is covered with sparse, dry, light brown herbaceous vegetation or leaf litter, consistent with a grassland understory that may be regularly cleared. Sunlight filters through the tree canopies, casting dappled light and shadows across the scene. No artificial structures or distinct agricultural rows are visible, indicating an extensive land use management system typical of Mediterranean agro-forestry areas.
